svg.text: Mixed-type CSV through a SIMD structural index. Typed columns and every field as a String.
Every field as a String · 1 MiB
Every field as a String · 128 MiB
Bars: median of six fresh processes (two interleaved groups of three on one host and CPU); whiskers: min–max of all six, not confidence intervals.
† Index scan is a Java consumer over the native index, with nothing retained; the batches retain typed columns or Strings for later reads. FastCSV and Jackson consume each record as it is read.
One quiet host (AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9965WX 24-Cores), every shard in sequence on one pinned CPU · Linux x86-64 · GraalVM Native Image · O2 · serial GC · no PGO.
